note: settings rows built on the 60 px list-item token instead of the design's 56 px; the band grows by 16 px
chip track uses the 12 px spacing token instead of 8 px between chips
group title takes the 16 px row padding-right value as its side padding; the design has 20 px
row titles set in the 17 px body style instead of 16 px medium
note inherits the 24 px line height of the row titles instead of 20 px; the band grows by 4 px
the +4 % tracking of the ACCOUNT overline is dropped
chip labels semibold instead of medium
row values (On, 2 cards, English) use gray-600 #475467 instead of gray-500 #667085
inactive chips filled with gray-200 #EAECF0 instead of gray-100 #F2F4F7
chips use the 8 px card radius instead of the 18 px pill radius

css: .settings li + li::before { display: none !important; } .settings li + li .row { border-top: 1px solid #EAECF0; }
note: dividers drawn as border-top on the 56 px row: they become full-bleed instead of inset from x 56, and each row loses 1 px (band 224 instead of 227)
leading icons at 20 px (the chevron size) instead of 24 px
divider colour token misspelled (var(--grey-200)), so the three inset dividers are not painted; the 1 px gaps stay
chevrons exported with a 50 % layer opacity on top of the #98A2B3 stroke, so they render much lighter
